name: SCRUM-9 - Validate New User Input Rules
objective: Verify required fields, password confirmation, and duplicate username validation prevent invalid user creation.
precondition: The administrator is logged in and an eligible employee record is available.

steps.description: Submit the Add User form without required fields.
steps.expectedResult: Required-field validation is displayed and no user is created.

steps.description: Submit otherwise valid details with mismatched passwords.
steps.expectedResult: Password confirmation validation is displayed and no user is created.

steps.description: Submit a username that already exists.
steps.expectedResult: Duplicate username validation is displayed and no user is created.
